Thanks for the ping — quick operational summary below (pulled from our DSR runbook, attached).

1) Controller vs Processor- For requests about BrightFin account data (end-user messages you send to the API, embeddings, model outputs stored under your workspace) BrightFin is the controller; Redwood is the processor acting on your instructions.- For Redwood-specific account metadata (billing contact, support ticket notes authored by Redwood staff, aggregated service telemetry that Redwood uses for product improvement) Redwood may be the controller or joint controller; we treat these categories separately in our DPA (see clause 2.1.b).

2) Verification & required evidence from BrightFin- For typical customer-initiated DSRs we require: the BrightFin ticket ID or a signed DSAR form, the subject's email or user id, and either the requesting controller's DPO approval or a legal contact email (legal@brightfin.com is fine). If BrightFin is acting as the controller and submits the DSAR, we accept controller-supplied verification to avoid contacting the end-user directly.

3) Deletion timeline & scope- Active data: we will mark records for deletion and remove access within 72 hours of verification; physical deletion/purging from primary stores occurs within 30 days (unless otherwise contractually specified).- Backups/replicas: backups are retained per our retention schedule; deletions from immutable backups occur during the next backup rotation and are treated as \"non-recoverable after rotation\" — we will provide an expected window (typically 90 days).- Audit evidence: we can provide a log excerpt (audit_log_excerpt.csv) showing deletion command, requestor, timestamp, and object IDs. We also provide a standardized confirmation template (dsr_confirmation_template.txt) signed by Redwood legal on request.

4) Export requests- If BrightFin requests an export of the subject's data prior to deletion, we can produce a zipped export (PDF/CSV/JSON) within 14 days after verification; export delivery will be via a secure S3 presigned link or direct transfer to your secure bucket.

5) Controller/processor statement & DPA/SCC references- We can provide a statement confirming processor role for account data and reference the DPA and SCCs. If BrightFin needs a formal declaration for audit, we'll attach our DPA excerpt and SCC addendum (we can also route you to the signed contract).

I've attached: dsr_runbook.pdf (internal runbook excerpt) and an audit_log_excerpt.csv (redacted, sample format).

If BrightFin can provide the ticket ID or signed DSAR, we will schedule the deletion workflow immediately and send confirmation when complete.

Hi Lisa — following up with the agreed process and immediate next steps. Apologies for the short note style — putting the steps and required artefacts in one place to meet your 72-hour window.

Summary (BrightFin = controller; Redwood = processor for account data):
- Role: Redwood confirms we act as processor for user data created and stored under BrightFin's workspace. We may be controller for Redwood-origin metadata (billing, support notes) — see DPA clause 2.1.b for specifics.
- Verification required from BrightFin: please reply with the BrightFin ticket ID for the user's request or attach a signed DSAR form (we accept a scanned copy). Legal contact confirmation (legal@brightfin.com) is sufficient to validate the controller-directed request.
- Deletion timeline:
  * We will mark record(s) as deleted and remove active access within 72 hours of your verification.
  * Physical purge from primary stores: within 30 days.
  * Backups: expected to be cleared on next rotation (estimated window 60–90 days).
- Audit evidence & delivery: upon completion we will provide a deletion confirmation email and attach a redacted audit log excerpt (object ids redacted to hashes if needed) plus the signed confirmation template. If you require a more detailed log for audit, please state the fields needed and we'll evaluate scope.
- Export (if requested): we can prepare an export package within 14 days of verified request; specify delivery method (secure S3 link or direct transfer to your bucket).

Next steps for BrightFin (please reply to this thread):
1) Confirm ticket ID or attach signed DSAR form.
2) Confirm whether you want an export prior to deletion.
3) If you require a formal DPA/SCC declaration for your records, let us know and we'll attach the DPA excerpt and SCC addendum.
